title: The Observatory Heist
summary: During a fierce thunderstorm, the priceless Starfire Diamond is stolen from the locked observatory vault. Players must investigate the scene, interrogate suspects, and uncover the truth behind the theft.

scenes.title: The Vault Room
scenes.description: The vault door is wide open. The diamond is missing. Rain hammers against the dome above. You see a broken glass case, a wet footprint, and a strange tool on the floor.

scenes.title: Observatory Lounge
scenes.description: The suspects are gathered. Dr. Vega looks nervous, Janitor Moore is defensive, and Visitor Chen seems calm. A coffee cup sits on the table.

scenes.title: Roof Access
scenes.description: The storm has passed. You find a wet rope and a small cloth fragment near the roof hatch. A faint trail leads away.

characters.name: Dr. Vega
characters.description: The head astronomer, nervous and sweating. Claims he was in his office during the theft.

characters.name: Janitor Moore
characters.description: The janitor, defensive and shifty. Says he was cleaning the restrooms.

characters.name: Visitor Chen
characters.description: A calm visitor who claims to be a tourist. He was in the gift shop.

characters.name: Security Guard Park
characters.description: The security guard on duty. He was patrolling the perimeter.

characters.name: Assistant Kim
characters.description: Dr. Vega's assistant, quiet and observant. She was in the library.

items.name: Broken glass
items.inspectText: The glass is thick but shattered cleanly. There's a tiny trace of oil on the edge.

items.name: Wet footprint
items.description: A muddy footprint near the vault.
items.inspectText: The footprint is large, size 12, with a distinct tread pattern. It's still wet.

items.name: Lockpick set
items.inspectText: High-quality lockpicks, slightly worn. One pick has a small notch.

items.name: Coffee cup
items.description: A half-empty coffee cup with lipstick stain.
items.inspectText: The cup is warm. The lipstick shade is a deep red, and there's a faint smell of almonds.

items.name: Visitor log
items.inspectText: Only Dr. Vega, Janitor Moore, and Visitor Chen signed in. The times show Chen arrived at 7pm, Moore at 6:30pm, Vega at 6pm. The theft was at 7:30pm.

items.name: Rope
items.description: A wet nylon rope tied to the roof hatch.
items.inspectText: The rope is strong and has a knot that looks like a sailor's knot. It's wet from the rain.

items.name: Cloth fragment
items.description: A torn piece of fabric caught on the hatch.
items.inspectText: Dark blue cotton, possibly from a uniform. It has a small stain that smells like chemicals.

clues.title: Oil on glass
clues.content: The glass shards have traces of machine oil, suggesting a tool was used.

clues.title: Footprint size
clues.content: The footprint is size 12, which matches Janitor Moore's shoes (he wears size 12 work boots).

clues.title: Notched lockpick
clues.content: The lockpick set has a notch on one pick, indicating it was custom-made.

clues.title: Lipstick and almonds
clues.content: The coffee cup has a deep red lipstick and almond scent. Assistant Kim wears that shade and uses almond-scented lotion.

clues.title: Timeline inconsistency
clues.content: Visitor Chen signed in at 7pm, but the theft was at 7:30pm. He had time to reach the vault if he went quickly.

clues.title: Sailor's knot
clues.content: The knot on the rope is a bowline, commonly used by sailors. Visitor Chen was a sailor before coming here.

clues.title: Chemical stain
clues.content: The cloth fragment has a chemical stain that matches the cleaning solvent used by Janitor Moore.

clues.title: Alibi check
clues.content: Dr. Vega claimed he was in his office, but the security camera shows him near the vault at 7:25pm.

clues.title: Motive financial
clues.content: Dr. Vega had significant gambling debts and needed money urgently.

clues.title: Motive revenge
clues.content: Janitor Moore was fired from his previous job for theft and holds a grudge against the wealthy.

dialogues.question: Dr. Vega, where were you during the theft?
dialogues.answer: I was in my office, preparing for the night's observations. I didn't hear anything because of the storm.

dialogues.question: Janitor Moore, what were you doing?
dialogues.answer: I was cleaning the restrooms on the ground floor. I have witnesses? No, everyone was elsewhere.

dialogues.question: Visitor Chen, can you confirm your whereabouts?
dialogues.answer: I was in the gift shop buying souvenirs. The clerk can vouch for me. But I did see Dr. Vega near the vault around 7:25pm.

dialogues.question: Security Guard Park, did you see anything unusual?
dialogues.answer: I saw a figure on the roof during the storm. Couldn't identify who, but they were wearing a dark blue uniform.

finalLogic.motive: Dr. Vega had gambling debts and needed the diamond to pay them off.
finalLogic.method: Dr. Vega used a custom lockpick to open the vault, smashed the glass with a tool (leaving oil), and escaped through the roof using a rope. He left a wet footprint because of the rain.
finalLogic.winEnding: You present the evidence: the custom lockpick, the chemical stain matching his uniform, and the security footage. Dr. Vega confesses. Justice is served.
finalLogic.failEnding: You accuse the wrong person. The real culprit escapes with the diamond. The case remains unsolved.
